# Client Research Brief

## 1. Basic Client Info

### Client name
Svara Naturals

### Website URL
https://svaraonline.in/

### Instagram URL
@svara_online

### One-line business description
Svara's alcohol-free, oil-based perfumes are gentle enough for daily use on pulse points and free from harsh chemicals, suitable for sensitive skin.

### Business type/category
D2C wellness fragrance / clean beauty

## 2. SOW Summary

### Client industry
Premium alcohol-free, oil-based perfumes and attars for D2C ecommerce with social-first launch support.

### Target audience
Urban millennials and Gen Z seeking clean, alcohol-free fragrances; sensitive-skin buyers; gift shoppers in India.

### Goals and requirements
Build brand awareness and shop intent on Instagram and Pinterest; educate on alcohol-free benefits; drive product discovery without medical claims.

### Strategy and launch plan
Month 1: brand introduction and education. Month 2: product storytelling and social proof. Month 3: conversion-focused reels and Pinterest shop pins.

### Content deliverables
12 Instagram posts, 4 Pinterest pins, 8 story sets, monthly calendar, caption directions, and CTA suggestions per post.

### Deliverables summary
- 12× Instagram posts per month
- 4× Pinterest pins per month
- 8× story sets per month
- 1× monthly content calendar

## 5. Audience Inputs

### Primary audience
Urban women 22–35 interested in clean beauty and everyday luxury.

### Pain points
Alcohol-based perfumes sting sensitive skin; overwhelming department-store choices.

### Desires
A signature scent that feels gentle, premium, and personal.

## 6. Positioning Inputs

### Value proposition
Alcohol-free fragrances that feel luxurious without irritating sensitive skin.

### Differentiators
Oil-based formula, clean ingredients, D2C pricing, India-made story.

Single perfumes, attar sets, discovery kits.

₹899–₹2499 range; bundles promoted during festivals. Not confirmed — needs client confirmation.

## 8. Tone of Voice Inputs

### Tone keywords
Gentle, sensory, clean, premium, approachable

### Words/claims to avoid
Medical cure claims; guaranteed results; clinical treatment language

## 9. Visual Identity Inputs

### Main visual vibe
Warm minimal clean beauty

### Color palette candidates
Sand, terracotta, cream, deep brown accents

## 10. Content Strategy Inputs

### Possible content pillars
Education, product spotlight, ritual/how-to, gifting, social proof

### Topics to avoid
Medical claims, competitor bashing, unverified before/after results

## 11. Claim and Safety Notes

### Claims allowed/visible
Alcohol-free, oil-based, gentle on skin, suitable for sensitive skin (as stated on site)

### Claims to avoid
Cures skin conditions; dermatologist-approved unless verified; guaranteed results

### Proof limitations
No clinical studies available; testimonials are anecdotal only.

### Sensitive category notes
Wellness/health claim caution: avoid medicalized fragrance claims.
